strongest_angle: Anthropic updated its usage policy to prohibit sustained and needless cruel or abusive behavior toward its AI model Claude, sparking debates on machine welfare and artificial consciousness.

key_facts.fact: The San Francisco-based AI lab Anthropic updated its usage policy on Thursday to include a prohibition on sustained and needless abusive or cruel behavior toward its AI models.
The new usage policy update containing rules against cruelty toward Claude goes into effect on November 12, according to reports by Reason and The Neuron.
Journalist Billy Binion reported for Reason on October 9, 2026, that Anthropic's updated policy covers standard fare like deceptive activity and elections alongside the new behavioral rules.
Pascal Schuster's analysis on Quants & Qualia noted that Anthropic's updated Acceptable Use Policy shifted its explicit purpose from helping users stay safe to preventing real-world harm.
